image-rollover__caption-icon-container"> Canada Soccer has announced that Canada Soccer's Men's National Team (CANMNT) will play its home leg of the 2026-27 Concacaf Nations League A Quarterfinals at BMO Field in Toronto on Monday, 16 November. Canada will play the first leg away with venue and opponent to be confirmed following the conclusion of the group stage this October. Canada earned a bye directly into the Quarterfinals as one of the region's four top-ranked nations, alongside Mexico, the United States and Panama, after finishing third in the 2024-25 Concacaf Nations League. The Quarterfinals will be played as a two-legged, home-and-away series decided on aggregate goals.
